name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlStart
description: The start time for commodity settlement where delivery occurs over time. The time format is specified by the settlement time type.

name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlEnd
description: The end time for commodity settlement where delivery occurs over time. The time format is specified by the settlement time type.

name: NoUnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriods
description: Number of commodity settlement periods in the repeating group.

name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlCountry
description: Specifies the country where delivery takes place. Uses ISO 3166 2-character country code.

name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlTimeZone
description:
Commodity delivery timezone specified as "prevailing" rather than "standard" or "daylight".
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/prevailing-timezones for code list of applicable prevailing timezones.

name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlFlowType
description: Specifies the commodity delivery flow type.

name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodNotional
description: Specifies the delivery quantity associated with this settlement period.

name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodNotionalUnitOfMeasure
description: Specifies the unit of measure (UOM) of the delivery quantity associated with this settlement period.

values.meaning: Principal with relation to debt instrument

name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodFrequencyPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the settlement period frequency.

name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodFrequencyUnit
description: Time unit associated with the settlement period frequency.

name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodPrice
description: The settlement period price.

name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodPriceUnitOfMeasure
description: Specifies the settlement period price unit of measure (UOM).

values.meaning: Principal with relation to debt instrument

name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodPriceCurrency
description: The currency of the settlement period price. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlHolidaysProcessingInstruction
description: Indicates whether holidays are included in the settlement periods. Required for electricity contracts.

name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodXID
description: Identifier of this settlement period for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodXIDRef
description: Cross reference to another settlement period for duplicating its properties.

name: UnderlyingStreamXID
description: Identifier of this UnderlyingStream for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondIssuer
description: Issuer of the bond.

name: UnderlyingStreamNotionalXIDRef
description: Cross reference to another UnderlyingStream notional for duplicating its properties.

name: UnderlyingStreamNotionalFrequencyPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the swap stream's notional frequency.

name: UnderlyingStreamNotionalFrequencyUnit
description: Time unit associated with the swap stream's notional frequency.

name: UnderlyingStreamNotionalCommodityFrequency
description: The commodity's notional or quantity delivery frequency.

name: UnderlyingStreamNotionalUnitOfMeasure
description: Specifies the delivery quantity unit of measure (UOM).

values.meaning: Principal with relation to debt instrument

name: UnderlyingStreamTotalNotional
description: Specifies the total notional or delivery quantity over the term of the contract.

name: UnderlyingStreamTotalNotionalUnitOfMeasure
description: Specifies the unit of measure (UOM) for the total notional or delivery quantity over the term of the contract.

values.meaning: Principal with relation to debt instrument

name: EncodedUnderlyingAdditionalTermBondIssuerLen
description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedUnderlyingAdditionalTermBondIssuer(42026) field.

name: EncodedUnderlyingAdditionalTermBondIssuer
description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondIssuer(42017) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondIssuer(42017) field.

name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondSeniority
description: Specifies the bond's payment priority in the event of a default.

name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondCouponType
description: Coupon type of the bond.

name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondCouponRate
description: Coupon rate of the bond. See also CouponRate(223).

name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondMaturityDate
description: The maturity date of the bond.

name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondParValue
description: The par value of the bond.

name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondCurrentTotalIssuedAmount
description: Total issued amount of the bond.

name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondCouponFrequencyPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondCouponFrequencyUnit
description: Time unit associated with the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondDayCount
description: The day count convention used in interest calculations for a bond or an interest bearing security.

name: NoUnderlyingAdditionalTerms
description: Number of additional terms in the repeating group.

name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermConditionPrecedentBondIndicator
description: Indicates whether the condition precedent bond is applicable. The swap contract is only valid if the bond is issued and if there is any dispute over the terms of fixed stream then the bond terms would be used.

name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermDiscrepancyClauseIndicator
description: Indicates whether the discrepancy clause is applicable.

name: NoUnderlyingCashSettlDealers
description: Number of dealers in the repeating group.

name: UnderlyingCashSettlDealer
description: Identifies the dealer from whom price quotations for the reference obligation are obtained for the purpose of cash settlement valuation calculation.

name: NoUnderlyingCashSettlTerms
description: Number of elements in the repeating group.

name: UnderlyingCashSettlCurrency
description: Specifies the currency the UnderlyingCashSettlAmount(42054) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: UnderlyingCashSettlValuationFirstBusinessDayOffset
description: The number of business days after settlement conditions have been satisfied, when the calculation agent is to obtain a price quotation on the reference obligation for purposes of cash settlement.

name: UnderlyingCashSettlValuationSubsequentBusinessDaysOffset
description: The number of business days between successive valuation dates when multiple valuation dates are applicable for cash settlement.

name: UnderlyingCashSettlNumOfValuationDates
description: Where multiple valuation dates are specified as being applicable for cash settlement, this element specifies the number of applicable valuation dates.

name: UnderlyingCashSettlValuationTime
description: Time of valuation.

name: UnderlyingCashSettlBusinessCenter
description:
Identifies the business center calendar used at valuation time for cash settlement purposes e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: UnderlyingCashSettlQuoteMethod
description: The type of quote used to determine the cash settlement price.

name: UnderlyingCashSettlQuoteAmount
description: When determining the cash settlement amount, if weighted average price quotes are to be obtained for the reference obligation, this is the upper limit to the outstanding principal balance of the reference obligation for which the quote should be obtained. If not specified, the ISDA definitions provide for a fallback amount equal to floating rate payer calculation amount.

name: UnderlyingCashSettlQuoteCurrency
description: Specifies the currency the UnderlyingCashSettlQuoteAmount(42049) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: UnderlyingCashSettlMinimumQuoteAmount
description: When determining the cash settlement amount, if weighted average price quotes are to be obtained for the reference obligation, this is the minimum intended threshold amount of outstanding principal balance of the reference obligation for which the quote should be obtained. If not specified, the ISDA definitions provide for a fallback amount of the lower of either USD1,000,000 (or its equivalent in the relevant obligation currency) or the (minimum) quoted amount.

name: UnderlyingCashSettlMinimumQuoteCurrency
description: Specifies the currency the UnderlyingCashSettlQuoteAmount(42049) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: UnderlyingCashSettlBusinessDays
description: The number of business days used in the determination of the cash settlement payment date.

name: UnderlyingCashSettlAmount
description: The amount paid between the trade parties, seller to the buyer, for cash settlement on the cash settlement date.

name: UnderlyingCashSettlRecoveryFactor
description: Used for fixed recovery, this specifies the recovery level as determined at contract inception, to be applied in the event of a default. The factor is used to calculate the amount paid by the seller to the buyer for cash settlement on the cash settlement date. The amount is calculated is (1 - UnderlyingCashSettlRecoveryFactor(42055)) x floating rate payer calculation amount. The currency is derived from the floating rate payer calculation amount.

name: UnderlyingCashSettlFixedTermIndicator
description: Indicates whether fixed settlement is applicable or not applicable in a recovery lock.

name: UnderlyingCashSettlAccruedInterestIndicator
description: Indicates whether accrued interest is included or not in the value provided in UnderlyingCashSettlAmount(42054).

name: UnderlyingCashSettlValuationMethod
description: The ISDA defined methodology for determining the final price of the reference obligation for purposes of cash settlement.

name: UnderlyingCashSettlTermXID
description: Name referenced from UnderlyingSettlementTermXIDRef(41315).

name: NoUnderlyingPhysicalSettlTerms
description: Number of entries in the repeating group.

name: UnderlyingPhysicalSettlCurrency
description: Currency of physical settlement. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: UnderlyingPhysicalSettlBusinessDays
description: A number of business days. Its precise meaning is dependent on the context in which this element is used.

name: UnderlyingPhysicalSettlMaximumBusinessDays
description: A maximum number of business days. Its precise meaning is dependent on the context in which this element is used. Intended to be used to limit a particular ISDA fallback provision.

name: UnderlyingPhysicalSettlTermXID
description: A named string value referenced by UnderlyingSettlTermXIDRef(41315).

name: NoUnderlyingPhysicalSettlDeliverableObligations
description: Number of entries in the repeating group.

name: UnderlyingPhysicalSettlDeliverableObligationType
description:
Specifies the type of delivery obligation applicable for physical settlement.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/deliverable-obligation-type for code list for applicable deliverable obligation types.

name: UnderlyingPhysicalSettlDeliverableObligationValue
description:
Physical settlement delivery obligation value appropriate to UnderlyingPhysicalSettlDeliverableObligationType(42066).
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/deliverable-obligation-type for applicable obligation type values.

name: NoUnderlyingProtectionTerms
description: Number of protection terms in the repeating group.

name: UnderlyingProtectionTermNotional
description: The notional amount of protection coverage for a floating rate.

name: UnderlyingProtectionTermCurrency
description: The currency of UnderlyingProtectionTermNotional(42069). Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: UnderlyingProtectionTermSellerNotifies
description: The notifying party is the party that notifies the other party when a credit event has occurred by means of a credit event notice. If more than one party is referenced as being the notifying party then either party may notify the other of a credit event occurring.

name: UnderlyingProtectionTermBuyerNotifies
description: The notifying party is the party that notifies the other party when a credit event has occurred by means of a credit event notice. If more than one party is referenced as being the notifying party then either party may notify the other of a credit event occurring.

name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventBusinessCenter
description:
When used, the business center indicates the local time of the business center that replaces the Greenwich Mean Time in Section 3.3 of the 2003 ISDA Credit Derivatives Definitions.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: UnderlyingProtectionTermStandardSources
description: Indicates whether ISDA defined Standard Public Sources are applicable (UnderlyingProtectionTermStandardSources(42074)=Y) or not.

name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventMinimumSources
description: The minimum number of the specified public information sources that must publish information that reasonably confirms that a credit event has occurred. The market convention is two.

name: UnderlyingProtectionTermXID
description: A named string value referenced by UnderlyingProtectionTermXIDRef(41314).

name: NoUnderlyingProtectionTermEvents
description: Number of protection term events in the repeating group.

name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventType
description:
Specifies the type of credit event applicable to the protection terms.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/protection-term-event-type for code list of applicable event types.

name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventValue
description:
Protection term event value appropriate to UnderlyingProtectionTermEventType(42078).
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/protection-term-event-type for applicable event type values.

name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventCurrency
description: Applicable currency if UnderlyingProtectionTermEventValue(42079) is an amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for protection term events.

name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventUnit
description: Time unit associated with protection term events.

name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventDayType
description: Day type for events that specify a period and unit.

name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventRateSource
description: Rate source for events that specify a rate source, e.g. Floating rate interest shortfall.

name: NoUnderlyingProtectionTermEventQualifiers
description: Number of qualifiers in the repeating group.

name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventQualifier
description: Protection term event qualifier. Used to further qualify UnderlyingProtectionTermEventType(43078).

name: NoUnderlyingProtectionTermObligations
description: Number of obligations in the repeating group.

name: UnderlyingProtectionTermObligationType
description:
Specifies the type of obligation applicable to the protection terms.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/protection-term-obligation-type for code list of applicable obligation types.

name: UnderlyingProtectionTermObligationValue
description:
Protection term obligation value appropriate to UnderlyingProtectionTermObligationType(42088).
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/protection-term-obligation-type for applicable obligation type values.

name: NoUnderlyingProtectionTermEventNewsSources
description: Number of event news sources in the repeating group.

name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventNewsSource
description: Newspaper or electronic news service or source that may publish relevant information used in the determination of whether or not a credit event has occurred.

name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateBusinessDayConvention
description: The business day convention used to adjust the provisional cash settlement payment's termination, or relative termination, date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement payment date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement payment date offset.

name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement payment date offset.

name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative cash settlement payment date offset.

name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRangeFirst
description: First date in range when a settlement date range is provided.

name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRangeLast
description: Last date in range when a settlement date range is provided.

name: NoUnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDates
description: Number of UnderlyingProvision cash settlement payment dates in the repeating group.

name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDate
description: The cash settlement payment date, unadjusted or adjusted depending on UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateType(42101).

name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateType
description: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlQuoteSource
description: Identifies the source of quote information.

name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlQuoteReferencePage
description: Identifies the reference "page" from the quote source.

name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueTime
description: A time specified in 24-hour format, e.g. 11am would be represented as 11:00:00. The time of the cash settlement valuation date when the cash settlement amount will be determined according to the cash settlement method if the parties have not otherwise been able to agree to the cash settlement amount.

name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueTimeBusinessCenter
description:
Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's cash settlement valuation time.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateBusinessDayConvention
description: The business day convention used to adjust the cash settlement valuation date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement value date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement value date offset.

name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement value date offset.

name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative cash settlement value date offset.

name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted cash settlement value date.

name: NoUnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDates
description: Number of UnderlyingProvision option exercise fixed dates in the repeating group.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDate
description: A predetermined option exercise date, unadjusted or adjusted depending on UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDateType(42114).

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDateType
description: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseBusinessDayConvention
description: The business day convention used to adjust the underlying instrument's provision's option exercise date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the interval to the first (and possibly only) exercise date in the exercise period.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the interval to the first (and possibly only) exercise date in the exercise period.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseFrequencyPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of subsequent exercise dates in the exercise period following the earliest exercise date. An interval of 1 day should be used to indicate an American style exercise frequency.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseFrequencyUnit
description: Time unit associated with the frequency of subsequent exercise dates in the exercise period following the earliest exercise date.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted first day of the exercise period for an American style option.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the option exercise start date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option exercise start date offset.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative option exercise start date offset.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option exercise start date offset.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted first day of the exercise period for an American style option.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExercisePeriodSkip
description: The number of periods in the referenced date schedule that are between each date in the relative date schedule. Thus a skip of 2 would mean that dates are relative to every second date in the referenced schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseBoundsFirstDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted first date of a schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of exercise dates when they are relative.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseBoundsLastDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted last date of a schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of exercise dates when they are relative.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestTime
description: The earliest time at which notice of exercise can be given by the buyer to the seller (or seller's agent) i) on the expriation date, in the case of a European style option, (ii) on each bermuda option exercise date and the expiration date, in the case of a Bermuda style option the commencement date to, and including, the expiration date, in the case of an American option.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestTimeBusinessCenter
description:
Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's earliest time for notice of exercise.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseLatestTime
description: For a Bermuda or American style option, the latest time on an exercise business day (excluding the expiration date) within the exercise period that notice can be given by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent. Notice of exercise given after this time will be deemed to have been given on the next exercise business day.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseLatestTimeBusinessCenter
description:
Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's latest time for notice of exercise.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted last day within an exercise period for an American style option. For a European style option it is the only day within the exercise period.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateBusinessDayConvention
description: The business day convention used to adjust the underlying instrument's provision's option expiration date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the option expiration date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option expiration date offset.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative option expiration date offset.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option expiration date offset.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted last date within an exercise period for an American style option. For a European style option it is the only date within the exercise period.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationTime
description: The latest time for exercise on the expiration date.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationTimeBusinessCenter
description:
Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's latest exercise time on expiration date.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted date on the underlying set by the exercise of an option. What this date is depends on the option (e.g. in a swaption it is the swap effective date, in an extendible/cancelable provision it is the swap termination date).

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateBizDayConvention
description: The business day convnetion used to adjust the underlying instrument provision's option underlying date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the date relevant to the underlying trade on exercise is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option relevant underlying date offset.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative option relevant underlying date offset.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option relevant underlying date offset.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted date on the underlying set by the exercise of an option. What this date is depends on the option (e.g. in a swaption it is the swap effective date, in an extendible/cancelable provision it is the swap termination date).

name: NoUnderlyingProvisions
description: Number of provisions in the repeating group.

name: UnderlyingProvisionType
description: Type of provision.

name: UnderlyingProvisionDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted date of the provision.

name: UnderlyingProvisionDateBusinessDayConvention
description: The business day convention used to adjust the underlying instrument's provision's date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

name: UnderlyingProvisionDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted date of the provision.

name: UnderlyingProvisionDateTenorPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the provision's tenor period.

name: UnderlyingProvisionDateTenorUnit
description: Time unit associated with the provision's tenor period.

name: UnderlyingProvisionCalculationAgent
description: Used to identify the calculation agent. The calculation agent may be identified in UnderlyingProvisionCalculationAgent(42156) or in the underlying provision parties component.

values.meaning: As specified in the master agreement
As specified in the standard terms supplement

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionSinglePartyBuyerSide
description: If optional early termination is not available to both parties then this component identifies the buyer of the option through its side of the trade.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionSinglePartySellerSide
description: If optional early termination is not available to both parties then this component identifies the seller of the option through its side of the trade.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseStyle
description: The instrument provision's exercise style.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseMultipleNotional
description: A notional amount which restricts the amount of notional that can be exercised when partial exercise or multiple exercise is applicable. The integral multiple amount defines a lower limit of notional that can be exercised and also defines a unit multiple of notional that can be exercised, i.e. only integer multiples of this amount can be exercised.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseMinimumNotional
description: The minimum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseMaximumNotional
description: The maximum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionMinimumNumber
description: The minimum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionMaximumNumber
description: The maximum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date. If the number is not specified, it means that the maximum number of options corresponds to the remaining unexercised options.

name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseConfirmation
description: Used to indicate whether follow-up confirmation of exercise (written or electronic) is required following telephonic notice by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent.

name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlMethod
description: An ISDA defined cash settlement method used for the determination of the applicable cash settlement amount. The method is defined in the 2006 ISDA Definitions, Section 18.3. Cash Settlement Methods, paragraph (e).

name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlCurrency
description: Specifies the currency of settlement. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlCurrency2
description: Specifies the currency of settlement for a cross-currency provision. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlQuoteType
description: Identifies the type of quote to be used.

name: UnderlyingProvisionText
description: Free form text to specify additional information or enumeration description when a standard value does not apply.

name: EncodedUnderlyingProvisionTextLen
description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedUnderlyingProvisionText(42712) field.

name: EncodedUnderlyingProvisionText
description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the UnderlyingProvisionText(42170) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the UnderlyingProvisionText(42170) field.

name: NoUnderlyingProvisionPartyIDs
description: Number of parties identified in the contract provision.

name: UnderlyingProvisionPartyID
description: The party identifier for the payment settlement party.

name: UnderlyingProvisionPartyIDSource
description: Identifies the class or source of the UnderlyingProvisionPartyID(42174) value.

values.meaning: UK National Insurance or Pension Number
US Employer or Tax ID Number
Taiwanese Qualified Foreign Investor ID QFII/FID
Directed broker three character acronym as defined in ISITC "ETC Best Practice" guidelines document

Settlement Entity Location (note if Local Market Settlement use "E=ISO Country Code") (see "Appendix 6-G" for valid values)
CSD participant/member code (e.g. Euroclear, DTC, CREST or Kassenverein number

name: UnderlyingProvisionPartyRole
description: Identifies the type or role of UnderlyingProvisionPartyID(42174) specified.

values.meaning: Order Origination Trader (associated with Order Origination Firm - i.e. trader who initiates/submits the order)
Executing Trader (associated with Executing Firm - actually executes)
Giveup Clearing Firm (firm to which trade is given up)
Competent Authority of the most relevant market in terms of liquidity (CAL)
Competent Authority of the Transaction (Execution) Venue (CATV)
Prime Broker providing General Trade Services

name: NoUnderlyingProvisionPartySubIDs
description: Number of sub-party IDs to be reported for the party.

name: UnderlyingProvisionPartySubID
description: Underlying provision party sub-identifier, if applicable for UnderlyingProvisionPartyID(42174).

name: UnderlyingProvisionPartySubIDType
description: The type of UnderlyingProvisionPartySubID(42178).

values.meaning: Registration number (for settlement instructions and confirmations)
Contract linked to commercial or treasury financing for this counterparty
Contract above clearing threshold for this counterparty

name: NoUnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateBusinessCenters
description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateBusinessCenter
description:
The business center calendar used to adjust the provision's cash settlement payment's termination, or relative termination, date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: NoUnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateBusinessCenters

description: Reference to the stream which details the compounding fixed or floating rate.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingSpread
description: The spread to be used for compounding. Used in scenarios where the interest payment is based on a compounding formula that uses a compounding spread in addition to the regular spread.

name: PaymentStreamInterpolationMethod
description: The method used when calculating the index rate from multiple points on the curve. The most common is linear method.

name: PaymentStreamInterpolationPeriod
description: Defines applicable periods for interpolation.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingFixedRate
description: The compounding fixed rate applicable to the payment stream.

name: NoPaymentStreamCompoundingDates
description: Number of dates in the repeating group.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingDate
description: The compounding date. The type of date is specified in PaymentStreamCompoundingDateType(42608).

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingDateType
description: Specifies the type of payment compounding date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingDatesBusinessDayConvention
description: The compounding dates business day convention.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingDatesRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the compounding dates are relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingDatesOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding date offset.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingDatesOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative compounding date offset.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingDatesOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding date offset.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingPeriodSkip
description: The number of periods in the "RelativeTo" schedule that are between each date in the compounding schedule. A skip of 2 would mean that compounding dates are relative to every second date in the "RelativeTo" schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingFrequencyPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency at which compounding dates occur.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingFrequencyUnit
description: Time unit associated with the frequency at which compounding dates occur.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingRollConvention
description: The convention for determining the sequence of compounding dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency.

name: PaymentStreamBoundsLastDateUnadjusted

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted compounding end date.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the compounding end date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding end date offset.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative compounding end date offset.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding end date offset.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted compounding end date.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndex
description: The payment stream's compounding floating rate index.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndexCurvePeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the payment stream's compounding floating rate index curve period.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndexCurveUnit
description: Time unit associated with the payment stream's compounding floating rate index curve period.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingRateMultiplier
description: A rate multiplier to apply to the compounding floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingRateSpread
description: The basis points spread from the index specified in PaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndex(42628).

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingRateSpreadPositionType
description: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingRateTreatment
description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the index.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingCapRate
description: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the compounding floating rate. It is only required where the compounding floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingCapRateBuySide
description: Reference to the buyer of the compounding cap rate option through its trade side.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingCapRateSellSide
description: Reference to the seller of the compounding cap rate option through its trade side.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingFloorRate
description: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the compounding floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the compounding floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate. The rate is expressed as a decimal, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingFloorRateBuySide
description: Reference to the buyer of the compounding floor rate option through its trade side.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingFloorRateSellSide
description: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingInitialRate
description: The initial compounding floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. The initial rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingFinalRateRoundingDirection
description: Specifies the rounding direction for the compounding floating rate.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingFinalRatePrecision
description: Specifies the compounding floating rate rounding precision in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingAveragingMethod
description: Specifies the averaging method when compounding floating rate averaging is applicable (e.g. weighted or unweighted).

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingNegativeRateTreatment
description: Specifies the method for calculating payment obligations when a compounding floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted compounding start date.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the compounding start date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding start date offset.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative compounding start date offset.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding start date offset.

name: PaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted compounding start date.

name: PaymentStreamFormulaImageLength
description: Length in bytes of the PaymentStreamFormulaImage(42563) field.

name: PaymentStreamFormulaImage
description: Image of the formula image when represented through an encoded clip in base64Binary.

name: PaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted final price payment date.

name: PaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the final price payment date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: PaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateOffsetfPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative final price payment date offset.

name: PaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative final price payment date offset.

name: PaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative final price payment date offset.

name: PaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted final price payment date.

name: NoPaymentStreamFixingDates
description: Number of fixing dates in the repeating group.

name: PaymentStreamFixingDate
description: The fixing date. The type of date is specified in PaymentStreamFixingDateType(42662).

name: PaymentStreamFixingDateType
description: Specifies the type of fixing date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

name: PaymentStreamFirstObservationDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted initial price observation date.

name: PaymentStreamFirstObservationDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the initial price observation date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: PaymentStreamFirstObservationDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the initial price observation date offset.

name: PaymentStreamFirstObservationDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted initial price observation date.

name: PaymentStreamUnderlierRefID
description: References the dividend underlier through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

name: ReturnRateNotionalReset
description: Indicates whether the term "Equity Notional Reset" as defined in the ISDA 2002 Equity Derivatives Definitions is applicable ("Y") or not.

name: PaymentStreamLinkInitialLevel
description: Price level at which the correlation or variance swap contract will strike.

name: PaymentStreamLinkClosingLevelIndicator
description: Indicates whether the correlation or variance swap contract will ("Y") strike off the closing level of the default exchange traded contract or not.

name: PaymentStreamLinkExpiringLevelIndicator
description: Indicates whether the correlation or variance swap contract will ("Y") strike off the expiring level of the default exchange traded contract or not.

name: PaymentStreamLinkEstimatedTradingDays
description: The expected number of trading days in the variance or correlation swap stream.

name: PaymentStreamLinkStrikePrice
description: The strike price of a correlation or variance swap stream.

name: PaymentStreamLinkStrikePriceType
description: For a variance swap specifies how PaymentStreamLinkStrikePrice(42673) is expressed.

name: PaymentStreamLinkMaximumBoundary
description: Specifies the maximum or upper boundary for variance or strike determination.

name: PaymentStreamLinkMinimumBoundary
description: Specifies the minimum or lower boundary for variance or strike determination.

name: PaymentStreamLinkNumberOfDataSeries
description: Number of data series for a correlation swap. Normal market practice is that correlation data sets are drawn from geographic market areas, such as America, Europe and Asia Pacific. Each of these geographic areas will have its own data series to avoid contagion.

name: PaymentStreamVarianceUnadjustedCap
description: Indicates the scaling factor to be multiplied by the variance strike price thereby making variance cap applicable.

name: PaymentStreamRealizedVarianceMethod
description: Indicates which price to use to satisfy the boundary condition.

name: PaymentStreamDaysAdjustmentIndicator
description: Indicates whether the contract specifies that the notional should be scaled by the number of days in range divided by the estimate trading days or not. The number of "days in range" refers to the number of returns that contribute to the realized volatility.

name: PaymentStreamNearestExchangeContractRefID
description: References a contract listed on an exchange through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

name: PaymentStreamVegaNotionalAmount
description: "Vega Notional" represents the approximate gain/loss at maturity for a 1% difference between RVol (realised volatility) and KVol (strike volatility). It does not necessarily represent the Vega risk of the trade.

name: NoPaymentStreamFormulas
description: Number of formulas in the repeating group.

name: PaymentStreamFormula
description: Contains an XML representation of the formula. Defined for flexibility in choice of language (MathML, OpenMath or text).

name: PaymentStreamFormulaDesc
description: A description of the math formula in PaymentStreamFormula(42684).

name: PaymentStreamFormulaCurrency
description: The currency in which the formula amount is denominated. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: PaymentStreamFormulaCurrencyDeterminationMethod
description:
Specifies the method according to which the formula amount currency is determined.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

name: PaymentStreamFormulaReferenceAmount
description:
Specifies the reference amount when this term either corresponds to the standard ISDA Definition (either the 2002 Equity Definition for the Equity Amount, or the 2000 Definition for the Interest Amount), or refers to a term defined elsewhere in the swap document.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/payment-amount-relative-to for code list of reference amounts.

description:

name: ProvisionBreakFeeElection
description: Type of fee elected for the break provision.

name: ProvisionBreakFeeRate
description: Break fee election rate when the break fee is proportional to the notional. A fee rate of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

name: NoReturnRateDates

name: ReturnRateDateMode

name: ReturnRateValuationDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative return rate valuation date offset.

name: ReturnRateValuationDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative return rate valuation date offset.

description: The unadjusted start date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

description:

name: ReturnRateValuationStartDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative return rate valuation start date offset.

name: ReturnRateValuationStartDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative return rate valuation start date offset.

name: ReturnRateValuationStartDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative return rate valuation start date offset.

name: ReturnRateValuationStartDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted start date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

name: ReturnRateValuationEndDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted end date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

name: ReturnRateValuationEndDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the return rate valuation end date is relative to an anchor date.

name: ReturnRateValuationEndDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative return rate valuation end date offset.

name: ReturnRateValuationEndDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative return rate valuation end date offset.

name: ReturnRateValuationEndDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative return rate valuation end date offset.

name: ReturnRateValuationEndDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted end date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

name: ReturnRateValuationFrequencyPeriod

Specifies the reference amount when the return rate amount is relative to another amount in the trade.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/payment-amount-relative-to for code list of relative amounts.

name: ReturnRateQuoteMeasureType
description:
Specifies the type of the measure applied to the return rate's asset, e.g. valuation, sensitivity risk. This could be an NPV, a cash flow, a clean price, etc.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/asset-measure for values.

name: ReturnRateQuoteUnits
description:
Specifies the units that the measure is expressed in. If not specified, the default is a price/value in currency units.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/price-quote-units for values.

name: ReturnRateQuoteMethod
description: Specifies the type of quote used to determine the return rate of the swap.

name: ReturnRateQuoteCurrency
description: Specifies the currency the return rate quote is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 Currency Code.

name: ReturnRateQuoteCurrencyType
description:
Specifies the type of currency, e.g. settlement currency, base currency, etc., that the quote is reported in.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/reporting-currency-type for values.

name: ReturnRateQuoteTimeType
description: Specifies how or the timing when the quote is to be obtained.

name: ReturnRateQuoteTime

name: ReturnRateQuotePricingModel

name: ReturnRateCashFlowType

name: ReturnRateValuationPriceOption

name: ReturnRateFinalPriceFallback
description: Specifies the fallback provision for the hedging party in the determination of the final price.

name: NoReturnRateInformationSources

name: UnderlyingDividendCapRate
description: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. It is only required where the floating rate is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

name: UnderlyingDividendCapRateBuySide
description: Reference to the buyer of the cap rate option through its trade side.

name: UnderlyingDividendCapRateSellSide
description: Reference to the seller of the cap rate option through its trade side.

name: UnderlyingDividendFloorRate
description: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate. The rate is expressed as a decimal, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

name: UnderlyingDividendFloorRateBuySide
description: Reference to the buyer of the floor rate option through its trade side.

name: UnderlyingDividendFloorRateSellSide
description: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

name: UnderlyingDividendInitialRate
description: The initial floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. This is assumed to be the first required reset rate for the first regular calculation period. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. The initial rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

name: UnderlyingDividendFinalRateRoundingDirection
description: Specifies the rounding direction of the final rate.

name: UnderlyingDividendFinalRatePrecision
description: Specifies the rounding precision of the final rate in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

name: UnderlyingDividendAveragingMethod
description: When averaging is applicable, used to specify whether a weighted or unweighted average method of calculation is to be used.

name: UnderlyingDividendNegativeRateTreatment
description: The specification of any provisions for calculating payment obligations when a floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the accrual payment date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative accrual payment date offset.

name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative accrual payment date offset.

name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative accrual payment date offset.

name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted accrual payment date.

name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateBusinessDayConvention
description: Accrual payment date adjustment business day convention.

name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted accrual payment date.

name: UnderlyingDividendReinvestmentIndicator
description: Indicates whether the dividend will be reinvested.

name: UnderlyingDividendEntitlementEvent
description: Defines the contract event which the receiver of the derivative is entitled to the dividend.

name: UnderlyingDividendAmountType
description: Indicates how the gross cash dividend amount per share is determined.

name: UnderlyingDividendUnderlierRefID
description: References the dividend underlier through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in a separate instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

name: UnderlyingExtraordinaryDividendPartySide
description: Reference to the party through its side in the trade who makes the determination whether dividends are extraordinary in relation to normal levels.

name: UnderlyingExtraordinaryDividendAmountType
description: Indicates how the extraordinary gross cash dividend per share is determined.

name: UnderlyingExtraordinaryDividendCurrency
description: The currency in which the excess dividend is denominated. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: UnderlyingExtraordinaryDividendDeterminationMethod
description:
Specifies the method in which the excess amount is determined.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualFixedRate
description: The dividend accrual fixed rate per annum expressed as a decimal.

name: UnderlyingDividendCompoundingMethod
description: The compounding method to be used when more than one dividend period contributes to a single payment.

name: UnderlyingDividendNumOfIndexUnits
description: The number of index units applicable to dividends.

name: UnderlyingDividendCashPercentage
description: Declared cash dividend percentage.

name: UnderlyingDividendCashEquivalentPercentage
description: Declared cash-equivalent dividend percentage. A value of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

name: UnderlyingNonCashDividendTreatment
description: Defines the treatment of non-cash dividends.

name: UnderlyingDividendComposition
description: Defines how the composition of dividends is to be determined.

name: UnderlyingSpecialDividendsIndicator
description: Indicates whether special dividends are applicable.

name: UnderlyingMaterialDividendsIndicator
description: Indicates whether material non-cash dividends are applicable.

name: UnderlyingOptionsExchangeDividendsIndicator
description: Indicates whether option exchange dividends are applicable.

name: UnderlyingAdditionalDividendsIndicator
description: Indicates whether additional dividends are applicable.

name: UnderlyingAllDividendsIndicator
description: Represents the European Master Confirmation value of 'All Dividends' which, when applicable, signifies that, for a given Ex-Date, the daily observed share price for that day is adjusted (reduced) by the cash dividend and/or the cash value of any non-cash dividend per share (including extraordinary dividends) declared by the issuer.

name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the FX trigger date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative FX trigger date offset.

name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative FX trigger date offset.

name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative FX trigger date offset.

name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted FX trigger date.

name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateBusinessDayConvention
description: The business day convention used for the FX trigger date adjustment.

name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted FX trigger date.

name: NoUnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateBusinessCenters
description: Number of entries in the UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateBusinessCenterGrp.

name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateBusinessCenter
description:
The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the instrument's FX trigger date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: NoUnderlyingDividendPayments
description: Number of entries in the repeating group.

name: UnderlyingDividendPaymentDate
description: Specifies the date that the dividend or coupon payment is due.

name: UnderlyingDividendPaymentAmount
description: The amount of the dividend or coupon payment.

name: UnderlyingDividendPaymentCurrency
description: Specifies the currency the UnderlyingDividendPaymentAmount(42857) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: UnderlyingDividendAccruedInterest
description: Accrued interest on the dividend or coupon payment.

name: UnderlyingDividendPayoutRatio
description: Specifies the actual dividend payout ratio associated with the equity or bond underlier.

name: UnderlyingDividendPayoutConditions
description: Specifies the dividend payout conditions that will be applied in the case where the actual ratio is not known, typically because of regulatory or legal uncertainties.

name: NoUnderlyingDividendPeriods
description: Number of entries in the UnderlyingDividendPeriodGrp component.

name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodSequence
description: Defines the ordinal dividend period. E.g. 1 = First period, 2 = Second period, etc.

name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodStartDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted date on which the dividend period will begin.

name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodEndDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted date on which the dividend period will end.

name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodUnderlierRefID
description: References the dividend underlier through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodStrikePrice
description: Specifies the fixed strike price of the dividend period.

name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodBusinessDayConvention
description: The dividend period dates business day convention.

name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodValuationDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted dividend period valuation date.

name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodValuationDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the dividend period valuation date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodValuationDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative dividend period valuation date offset.

name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodValuationDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative dividend period valuation date offset.

name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodValuationDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative dividend period valuation date offset.

name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodValuationDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted dividend period valuation date.

name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodPaymentDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted dividend period payment date.

name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodPaymentDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the dividend period payment date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative dividend period payment date offset.

name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodPaymentDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative dividend period payment date offset.

name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodPaymentDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative dividend period payment date offset.

name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodPaymentDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted dividend period payment date.

name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodXID
description: Identifier for linking this stream dividend period to an underlier through an instance of RelatedInstrumentGrp.

name: NoUnderlyingDividendPeriodBusinessCenters
description: Number of entries in UnderlyingDividendPeriodBusinessCenterGrp.

name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodBusinessCenter
description:
The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the instrument's dividend period date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: NoUnderlyingExtraordinaryEvents
description: Number of extraordinary events in the repeating group.

name: UnderlyingExtraordinaryEventType
description:
Identifies the type of extraordinary or disruptive event applicable to UnderlyingExtraordinaryEventType(42885).
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/extraordinary-event-type for code list of extraordinary event types and values.

name: UnderlyingExtraordinaryEventValue
description:
The extraordinary or disruptive event value appropriate to UnderlyingExtraordinaryEventType(42885).
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/extraordinary-event-type for code list of extraordinary event types and values.

name: UnderlyingSettlMethodElectingPartySide
description: Side value of the party electing the settlement method.

name: UnderlyingMakeWholeDate
description: The date through which the option cannot be exercised without penalty.

name: UnderlyingMakeWholeAmount
description: Amount to be paid by the buyer of the option if the option is exercised prior to the UnderlyingMakeWholeDate(42888).

name: UnderlyingMakeWholeBenchmarkCurveName
description: Identifies the benchmark floating rate index.

name: UnderlyingMakeWholeBenchmarkCurvePoint
description: The point on the floating rate index curve.

name: UnderlyingMakeWholeRecallSpread
description: Spread over the floating rate index.

name: UnderlyingMakeWholeBenchmarkQuote
description: The quote side of the benchmark to be used for calculating the "make whole" amount.

name: UnderlyingMakeWholeInterpolationMethod
description: The method used when calculating the "make whole" amount. The most common is linear method.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCashSettlIndicator
description: Indicates whether cash settlement is applicable.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingXIDRef
description: Reference to the stream which details the compounding fixed or floating rate.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingSpread
description: The spread to be used for compounding. Used in scenarios where the interest payment is based on a compounding formula that uses a compounding spread in addition to the regular spread.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInterpolationMethod
description: The method used when calculating the index rate from multiple points on the curve. The most common is linear method.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInterpolationPeriod
description: Defines applicable periods for interpolation.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingFixedRate
description: The compounding fixed rate applicable to the payment stream.

name: NoUnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDates
description: Number of dates in the repeating group.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDate
description: The compounding date. Type of date is specified in UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDateType(42903).

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDateType
description: Specifies the type of payment compounding date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesBusinessDayConvention
description: The compounding dates business day convention.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the compounding dates are relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding date offset.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative compounding date offset.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding date offset.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingPeriodSkip
description: The number of periods in the "RelativeTo" schedule that are between each date in the compounding schedule. A skip of 2 would mean that compounding dates are relative to every second date in the "RelativeTo" schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingFrequencyPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency at which compounding dates occur.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingFrequencyUnit
description: Time unit associated with the frequency at which compounding dates occur.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRollConvention
description: The convention for determining the sequence of compounding dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamBoundsFirstDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted first date of the compounding schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamBoundsLastDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted last date of the compounding schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

name: NoUnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesBusinessCenters
description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesBusinessCenter
description:
The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the payment stream compounding dates, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted compounding end date.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the compounding end date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding end date offset.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative compounding end date offset.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding end date offset.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted compounding end date.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndex
description: The payment stream's compounding floating rate index.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndexCurvePeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the payment stream's compounding floating rate index curve period.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndexCurveUnit
description: Time unit associated with the payment stream's compounding floating rate index curve period.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateMultiplier
description: A rate multiplier to apply to the compounding floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateSpread
description: The basis points spread from the index specified in UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndex(42923).

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateSpreadPositionType
description: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateTreatment
description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the index.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingCapRate
description: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the compounding floating rate. It is only required where the compounding floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingCapRateBuySide
description: Reference to the buyer of the compounding cap rate option through its trade side.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingCapRateSellSide
description: Reference to the seller of the compounding cap rate option through its trade side.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingFloorRate
description: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the compounding floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the compounding floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate. The rate is expressed as a decimal, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingFloorRateBuySide
description: Reference to the buyer of the compounding floor rate option through its trade side.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingFloorRateSellSide
description: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingInitialRate
description: The initial compounding floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. The initial rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingFinalRateRoundingDirection
description: Specifies the rounding direction for the compounding floating rate.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingFinalRatePrecision
description: Specifies the compounding floating rate rounding precision in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingAveragingMethod
description: Specifies the averaging method when compounding floating rate averaging is applicable (e.g. weighted or unweighted).

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingNegativeRateTreatment
description: Specifies the method for calculating payment obligations when a compounding floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted compounding start date.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the compounding start date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding start date offset.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative compounding start date offset.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding start date offset.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted compounding start date.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormulaImageLength
description: Length in bytes of the UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormulaImage(42948) field.

description: Image of the formula image when represented through an encoded clip in base64Binary.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateRelativeTo

Specifies the anchor date when the final price payment date is relative to an anchor date.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateOffsetUnit
