name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative final price payment date offset.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted final price payment date.

name: NoUnderlyingPaymentStreamFixingDates
description: Number of fixing dates in the repeating group.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixingDate
description: The fixing date. Type of date is specified in UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixingDateType(42957).

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixingDateType
description: Specifies the type of fixing date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted initial price observation date.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the initial price observation date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the initial price observation date offset.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted initial price observation date.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamUnderlierRefID
description: References the dividend underlier through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateNotionalReset
description: Indicates whether the term "Equity Notional Reset" as defined in the ISDA 2002 Equity Derivatives Definitions is applicable ("Y") or not.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkInitialLevel
description: Price level at which the correlation or variance swap contract will strike.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkClosingLevelIndicator
description: Indicates whether the correlation or variance swap contract will ("Y") strike off the closing level of the default exchange traded contract or not.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkExpiringLevelIndicator
description: Indicates whether the correlation or variance swap contract will ("Y") strike off the expiring level of the default exchange traded contract or not.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkEstimatedTradingDays
description: The expected number of trading days in the variance or correlation swap stream.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkStrikePrice
description: The strike price of a correlation or variance swap stream.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkStrikePriceType
description: For a variance swap specifies how UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkStrikePrice(42968) is expressed.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkMaximumBoundary
description: Specifies the maximum or upper boundary for variance or strike determination.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkMinimumBoundary
description: Specifies the minimum or lower boundary for variance or strike determination.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkNumberOfDataSeries
description: Number of data series for a correlation swap. Normal market practice is that correlation data sets are drawn from geographic market areas, such as America, Europe and Asia Pacific. Each of these geographic areas will have its own data series to avoid contagion.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamVarianceUnadjustedCap
description: Indicates the scaling factor to be multiplied by the variance strike price thereby making variance cap applicable.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRealizedVarianceMethod
description: Indicates which price to use to satisfy the boundary condition.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamDaysAdjustmentIndicator
description: Indicates whether the contract specifies that the notional should be scaled by the number of days in range divided by the estimate trading days or not. The number of "days in range" refers to the number of returns that contribute to the realized volatility.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamNearestExchangeContractRefID
description: References a contract listed on an exchange through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamVegaNotionalAmount
description: Vega Notional represents the approximate gain/loss at maturity for a 1% difference between RVol (realised volatility) and KVol (strike volatility). It does not necessarily represent the Vega risk of the trade.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormulaCurrency
description: The currency in which the formula amount is denominated. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormulaCurrencyDeterminationMethod
description:
Specifies the method according to which the formula amount currency is determined.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormulaReferenceAmount
description:
Specifies the reference amount when this term either corresponds to the standard ISDA Definition (either the 2002 Equity Definition for the Equity Amount, or the 2000 Definition for the Interest Amount), or refers to a term defined elsewhere in the swap document.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/payment-amount-relative-to for code list of reference amounts.

description: Contains an XML representation of the formula. Defined for flexibility in choice of language (MathML, OpenMath or text).
